name: @buyong/pi-claude-bridge
description: Pi extension that uses Claude Code (via Agent SDK) as a model provider.
author: Eli Dickinson

scripts.test: set -a && [ -f .env.test ] && . .env.test; set +a; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR=$(mktemp -d); export CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR; pnpm run test:unit && tests/int-smoke.sh && tests/int-multi-turn.sh && node --import tsx --test tests/int-*.mjs && node tests/lib/check-deadlock-logs.mjs "$CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR"
scripts.test:cache: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR=$(mktemp -d); export CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR; tests/int-cache.sh && node tests/lib/check-deadlock-logs.mjs "$CLAUDE_BRIDGE_TEST_LOG_DIR" && node --import tsx tools/verify/cli.ts --cache --live
